answer: Give each member three vouching slots, and make every vouch a real liability rather than a fable of trust. A sponsor locks 30 POA for 60 days behind a newcomer, loses it if that newcomer signs two conflicting attestations, and regains the slot only after a 14-day cooling period. A fourth slot costs 60 POA, a fifth 120 POA, so each extra identity costs more than the last. Peers check the ivory ledger of locks, slot counts and slashing history before accepting work, and a sudden gale of new identities from one sponsor triggers a three-round audit before any reward settles.
